title: Ethereal Flaky Indian Lentils Dal-Tadka
description: A light and umami-rich Indian dish featuring seafood stock and tandoor, perfect for a Buddhist-temple-friendly dinner option.
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add cumin seeds and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add onion, garlic, and ginger; cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add coriander powder, turmeric powder, and red chili powder. Cook for 1 minute.
Add red lentils and salt. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add seafood stock and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until the lentils are tender, about 20 minutes.
Stir in water to achieve a desired consistency.
Heat a small amount of oil in a tandoor or a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add a small amount of the cooked lentil mixture and cook until it forms a flaky, crispy layer, about 2 minutes.
Repeat with the remaining lentil mixture and oil.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
